title: A store-in-repair wait can drop earlier durability-pending registration evidence
outcome: A registration that first got a validated durability-pending reply keeps that pending evidence through any later store-in-repair wait, so the run is never recorded as a plain failure while its earlier write is unconfirmed.
acceptance: When a durability-pending reply precedes a store-transient reply for the same request, the wait either gives the pending evidence precedence or carries it onto the exhaustion error, and createRun records the registration as pending, not failed.
A behavioural test drives pending then store-transient replies to exhaustion and shows the pending evidence is kept.
